title: I Built a Better Codex Pet Than OpenAI Did
why_read: A lighthearted personal project post about building a competing 'desktop pet' feature for coding agents, entertaining but of minimal technical substance.
analysis: This is a casual blog post about the author building their own version of OpenAI's Codex Pets feature, a cute animated overlay showing coding agent status, for a Linux alpha project called Mochi. The author openly acknowledges it's not a fair comparison since Codex Pets is a polished multi-platform feature from a large company. There's little genuine technical depth here, it reads mainly as a fun side-project writeup rather than something offering transferable engineering insight.
